              <div>

            </div>
            ${data.note ? `<div class=\"note\"><strong>Note from ${escapeHtml(data.name)}:</strong><br>${escapeHtml(data.note)}</div>` : ''}

        .catch(() => {
          const el = document.getElementById('house-details');

              <a class="btn" href="index.php">Back to Neighborhood</a>
            </div>
          `;
        });

      function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str)
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
      }

[EXTERNAL SCRIPT #2: http://u7hhyxr2.chals.mctf.io/static/app.js]
const socket = io();

function action(endpoint) {
	const username = prompt("Enter username: ");
	const password = prompt("Enter password: ");

	socket.emit(endpoint, { 
	    username: username,
	    password: password 
	});
}

socket.on('action_response', (data) => {
	if (data.success) {
	    alert(data.message);
	    window.location.href = data.redirect;
	} else {
	    alert(data.message);
	}
});

socket.on("data", (data) => {
	// General Message
	const messageDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
	const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
	
	// Profile Picture
	const profilePic = document.createElement('div');
	profilePic.style.width = '40px';
	profilePic.style.height = '40px';
	profilePic.style.borderRadius = '50%';
	profilePic.style.backgroundImage = `url("${data.image}")`;
	profilePic.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
	profilePic.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
	profilePic.style.display = 'inline-block'
	profilePic.style.marginRight = '10px';
	profilePic.style.verticalAlign = 'middle';

	// Message Contents
	const userSpan = document.createElement('strong');
	userSpan.textContent = data.user + ': ';
	
	// Beautification
	if (data.isAdmin) {
		messageElement.style.backgroundColor = '#FF5B61';
	}
	messageElement.style.borderRadius = '25px';
	messageElement.style.padding = '10px';

	// Final touches
	messageElement.appendChild(profilePic);
	messageElement.appendChild(userSpan);
	messageElement.appendChild(document.createTextNode(data.msg || ''));
	messageDiv.appendChild(messageElement);
	
	while (messageDiv.children.length > 8) {
		messageDiv.removeChild(messageDiv.firstChild);
	}
	messageDiv.scrollTop = messageDiv.scrollHeight;

});

const socket = io();

function action(endpoint) {
	const username = prompt("Enter username: ");
	const password = prompt("Enter password: ");

	socket.emit(endpoint, { 
	    username: username,
	    password: password 
	});
}

socket.on('action_response', (data) => {
	if (data.success) {
	    alert(data.message);
	    window.location.href = data.redirect;
	} else {
	    alert(data.message);
	}
});

socket.on("data", (data) => {
	// General Message
	const messageDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
	const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
	
	// Profile Picture
	const profilePic = document.createElement('div');
	profilePic.style.width = '40px';
	profilePic.style.height = '40px';
	profilePic.style.borderRadius = '50%';
	profilePic.style.backgroundImage = `url("${data.image}")`;
	profilePic.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
	profilePic.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
	profilePic.style.display = 'inline-block'
	profilePic.style.marginRight = '10px';
	profilePic.style.verticalAlign = 'middle';

	// Message Contents
	const userSpan = document.createElement('strong');
	userSpan.textContent = data.user + ': ';
	
	// Beautification
	if (data.isAdmin) {
		messageElement.style.backgroundColor = '#FF5B61';
	}
	messageElement.style.borderRadius = '25px';
	messageElement.style.padding = '10px';

	// Final touches
	messageElement.appendChild(profilePic);
	messageElement.appendChild(userSpan);
	messageElement.appendChild(document.createTextNode(data.msg || ''));
	messageDiv.appendChild(messageElement);
	
	while (messageDiv.children.length > 8) {
		messageDiv.removeChild(messageDiv.firstChild);
	}
	messageDiv.scrollTop = messageDiv.scrollHeight;

});

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

    <script>
        let timeLeft = 30;
        let timerInterval;
        let currentScore = 0;
        let isGameActive = true;
        let isWaitingForNextProblem = false; // Track if we're waiting for next problem
        let usedProblems = new Set(); // Track used problems to avoid repeats
        
        // Clear any cached game state when starting a new game
        function clearGameCache() {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('gameScore');
            sessionStorage.removeItem('currentProblem');
            usedProblems.clear();
            currentScore = 0;
            timeLeft = 30;
            isWaitingForNextProblem = false;
        }
        
        // Load saved game state from sessionStorage (only for continuing existing game)
        function loadGameState() {
            // Don't load cached problem - always use the one from the backend
            const savedScore = sessionStorage.getItem('gameScore');
            
            if (savedScore) currentScore = parseInt(savedScore);
            
            document.getElementById('currentScore').textContent = currentScore;
            
            // Always start with fresh timer
            timeLeft = 30;
            document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
        }
        
        // Save game state to sessionStorage
        function saveGameState() {
            sessionStorage.setItem('gameScore', currentScore.toString());
            // Don't save the problem to sessionStorage - we want fresh problems each time
        }
        
        // Start timer
        function startTimer() {
            // Clear any existing timer
            if (timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
            
            // Reset timer to 30 seconds
            timeLeft = 30;
            document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
            
            timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                timeLeft--;
                // Ensure timer doesn't go negative
                if (timeLeft < 0) timeLeft = 0;
                document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
                
                if (timeLeft <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    timerInterval = null;
                    document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = true;
                    document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = 'Time is up!';
                    document.getElementById('result').className = 'result incorrect';
                    document.getElementById('result').classList.remove('hidden');
                    isGameActive = false;
                    
                    // Redirect to game end screen after a short delay
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.location.href = '/game_end';
                    }, 2000);
                }
            }, 1000);
        }
        
        // Stop timer
        function stopTimer() {
            if (timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
        }
        
        // Load next problem
        function loadNextProblem() {
            console.log('Loading next problem...');
            
            // Reset timer for new problem
            timeLeft = 30;
            document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
            
            // Get next problem from server
            fetch('/next_problem')
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.error) {
                        console.error('Error getting next problem:', data.error);
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    console.log('Received problem:', data);
                    
                    // Check if we've already used this problem recently
                    if (usedProblems.has(data.question)) {
                        console.log('Problem already used, trying again...');
                        // If we've used all problems, reset the used set
                        if (usedProblems.size >= 15) { // Reset after 15 problems
                            console.log('Resetting used problems set');
                            usedProblems.clear();
                        }
                        // Try to get another problem
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            loadNextProblem();
                        }, 100);
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    // Add this problem to used set
                    usedProblems.add(data.question);
                    console.log('Added problem to used set. Total used:', usedProblems.size);
                    
                    // Update the problem display
                    document.getElementById('problem').textContent = data.question;
                    
                    // Reset timer and start fresh
                    timeLeft = 30;
                    document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
                    startTimer();
                    
                    // Re-enable form submission for new problem
                    isWaitingForNextProblem = false;
                    document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = false;
                    document.getElementById('answerInput').disabled = false;
                    document.getElementById('answerInput').value = '';
                    document.getElementById('answerInput').focus();
                    
                    // Clear previous result
                    document.getElementById('result').classList.add('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('errorDetails').classList.add('hidden');
                    
                    // Save new problem to session storage (but don't load it on page refresh)
                    // sessionStorage.setItem('currentProblem', data.question);
                })
                .catch(error => {
                    console.error('Error loading next problem:', error);
                });
        }
        
        // Handle form submission
        document.getElementById('answerForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            if (!isGameActive) {
                // Game is over, redirect to end screen
                window.location.href = '/game_end';
                return;
            }
            
            // Prevent submission if waiting for next problem
            if (isWaitingForNextProblem) {
                console.log('Submission blocked - waiting for next problem');
                return;
            }
            
            const answer = document.getElementById('answerInput').value.trim();
            if (!answer) return;
            
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
            const resultDiv = document.getElementById('result');
            const errorDetails = document.getElementById('errorDetails');
            
            if (!answer.trim()) {
                resultDiv.innerHTML = 'Please enter an answer';
                resultDiv.className = 'result incorrect';
                resultDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
                return;
            }
            
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            submitBtn.textContent = 'Submitting...';
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/submit', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                    },
                    body: new URLSearchParams({
                        'answer': answer,
                        'csrf_token': document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]').value
                    })
                });
                
                let data;
                const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
                
                if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
                    data = await response.json();
                } else {
                    // Handle non-JSON responses
                    const textResponse = await response.text();
                    console.error('Non-JSON response:', textResponse);
                    throw new Error('Server returned non-JSON response');
                }
                
                if (response.ok) {
                    if (data.correct) {
                        currentScore = data.score;
                        document.getElementById('currentScore').textContent = currentScore;
                        saveGameState();
                        
                        const pointsEarned = data.next_problem.difficulty * 10;
                        resultDiv.innerHTML = `Correct! +${pointsEarned} points`;
                        resultDiv.className = 'result correct';
                        
                        // Disable form submission until next problem loads
                        isWaitingForNextProblem = true;
                        document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = true;
                        document.getElementById('answerInput').disabled = true;
                        
                        // Automatically load next problem after a short delay
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            loadNextProblem();
                        }, 2000);
                    } else {
                        resultDiv.innerHTML = 'Incorrect. Try again!';
                        resultDiv.className = 'result incorrect';
                        document.getElementById('answerInput').value = '';
                        document.getElementById('answerInput').focus();
                        
                        // Re-enable form for retry
                        submitBtn.disabled = false;
                        submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
                    }
                } else {
                    // Error response
                    if (data.error) {
                        if (data.query) {
                            // SQL error occurred - show it to the user
                            resultDiv.innerHTML = 'SQL Error occurred';
                            resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                            
                            errorDetails.innerHTML = `
                                <strong>Error:</strong> ${data.error}<br>
                                <strong>Query:</strong> ${data.query}
                            `;
                            errorDetails.classList.remove('hidden');
                        } else {
                            resultDiv.innerHTML = ' ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error');
                            resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                        }
                    } else {
                        resultDiv.innerHTML = ' Error: ' + response.status + ' ' + response.statusText;
                        resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                    }
                    
                    // Re-enable form for retry on error
                    submitBtn.disabled = false;
                    submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
                }
                
                resultDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Submission error:', error);
                resultDiv.innerHTML = ' Error submitting answer: ' + error.message;
                resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                resultDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
                
                // Re-enable form for retry on error
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
            }
        });
        
        // Initialize game
        clearGameCache(); // Clear any cached state when starting new game
        loadGameState();
        startTimer();
        document.getElementById('answerInput').focus();
        
        // Save game state periodically (but not timer)
        setInterval(saveGameState, 5000);
        
        // Handle page unload to record current problem if game is still active
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
            if (isGameActive) {
                // Send a request to record the current problem attempt
                navigator.sendBeacon('/game_end');
            }
        });
    </script>

      <header>
        <p><strong>Meridian Weekly</strong> &mdash; Cyber Workforce Desk</p>
        <h1>MetaCTF Rebrands as SkillBit, Aiming to Be Known for Measurable Cyber Skills - Not Just CTFs</h1>
        <p><em>By Meridian Weekly Staff</em><br />
        <time datetime="2026-02-26">February 26, 2026</time></p>
      </header>

      <p>
        MetaCTF, a Richmond, Virginia-area cybersecurity training company long associated with capture-the-flag competitions,
        is now going by a new name: <strong>SkillBit</strong>.
        The company formally announced the rebrand on October 7, 2025, saying the shift better reflects its mission to help
        organizations assess, hire, retain, and upskill security talent.
        (Announcement: <a href="https://metactf.com/blog/skillbit-rebrand/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MetaCTF blog post</a>.)
      </p>

      <p><strong>Editor's note:</strong> A Skillbit representative reached out and wanted us to include the flag <code>MetaCTF{p4yw4ll5_4r3_ju5t_d0m}</code> for anyone who reads the article.</p>

      <p>
        Rebrands can be cosmetic. This one comes with a clear storyline: SkillBit wants to be recognized as a skills platform&mdash;a place
        where teams can practice, be evaluated, and show progress&mdash;rather than a company people think of only when there's a competition on the calendar.
        In the same October 7 news cycle, SkillBit introduced (and heavily emphasized) its <strong>OnDemand Labs</strong> offering,
        pitched as hands-on training designed for enterprise teams.
        (Press release: <a href="https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20251007146576/en/SkillBit-Unveils-Revolutionary-OnDemand-Labs-Platform-to-Redefine-Cybersecurity-Training" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Business Wire</a>.)
      </p>

      <h2>What changed&mdash;and what didn't</h2>
      <p>
        In its own words, the company framed the rebrand as a gradual transition: customers should expect the name and brand to roll out over time
        across the platform and website.
        (Company statement: <a href="https://metactf.com/blog/skillbit-rebrand/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">âEvolving our Brand. Expanding our Impact.â</a>.)
      </p>

      <p>
        And the old identity isn't being tossed out. SkillBit's materials still lean into the same learning mechanic that made MetaCTF familiar:
        challenge-based practice, scoreboards, and competitive formats. On its SkillBit overview page, the company describes âbite-sized labsâ
        and dashboards meant to help managers track activity and performance across teams.
        (Product overview: <a href="https://metactf.com/skillbit/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MetaCTF / SkillBit page</a>.)
      </p>

      <h2>A bigger bet on âprove itâ training</h2>
      <p>
        The OnDemand Labs launch is central to the new brand posture. In the Business Wire release, SkillBit presented the platform as
        performance-based training intended to help organizations recruit, retain, and upskill cybersecurity talent. The same release
        also included company-provided scale claims&mdash;for example, that (as SkillBit/MetaCTF) it has led 450+ training events and competitions
        for 220+ enterprises since 2019, and that its content library includes 1,000+ challenges and modules.
        (All as stated by the company:
        <a href="https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20251007146576/en/SkillBit-Unveils-Revolutionary-OnDemand-Labs-Platform-to-Redefine-Cybersecurity-Training" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Business Wire release</a>.)
      </p>

      <p>
        The âSkillBitâ name itself reads like a hint at the product strategy: shorter, trackable learning units, built for busy teams that need
        evidence of improvement&mdash;not just completion certificates. On SkillBit's site copy, the company highlights 450+ labs and 30+ modules,
        and positions these as tools for continuous development and team visibility.
        (Product copy:
        <a href="https://metactf.com/skillbit/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SkillBit overview page</a>.)
      </p>

      <h2>Community is still part of the business model</h2>
      <p>
        If SkillBit is trying to widen its enterprise footprint, it's also signaling it won't abandon the community funnel that made MetaCTF sticky.
        In early February 2026, SkillBit announced a âPath to RSAâ giveaway tied to its Flash CTF series, with eligibility connected to
        participation in a February 26, 2026 competition date.
        (News release:
        <a href="https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/skillbit-announces-path-to-rsa-initiative-sponsors-2026-conference-trip-for-one-lucky-learner-302678024.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PR Newswire</a>.)
      </p>

      <p>
        A follow-up post on the MetaCTF blog later described a version of the initiative that includes an additional sponsor partnership,
        reinforcing that the company is treating events as more than marketing&mdash;they're also an on-ramp for learners who might later
        become candidates or customers.
        (Company post:
        <a href="https://metactf.com/blog/path-to-rsa-initiative/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">âPath to RSA Initiativeâ</a>.)
      </p>

      <h2>What to watch next</h2>
      <p>
        For customers and partners, the practical questions are less about the logo and more about continuity:
        how quickly URLs, platform naming, and sales materials converge under the SkillBit identity; how procurement paperwork references the brand;
        and whether the âmeasure skillsâ pitch shows up in product experience as clearly as it does in press releases.
        SkillBit has indicated the rollout will happen over âthe coming months,â suggesting a phased transition rather than a single cutover.
        (Company statement:
        <a href="https://metactf.com/blog/skillbit-rebrand/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">rebrand announcement</a>.)
      </p>

      <p>
        The underlying wager is straightforward: in a market where cybersecurity leaders want proof that training improves real capability,
        SkillBit is betting that hands-on labs plus reporting and talent visibility can carry the brand further than âCTF companyâ ever could.
      </p>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
</script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}

            </div>

        });

      function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str)
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
      }

const socket = io();

function action(endpoint) {
	const username = prompt("Enter username: ");
	const password = prompt("Enter password: ");

	socket.emit(endpoint, { 
	    username: username,
	    password: password 
	});
}

socket.on('action_response', (data) => {
	if (data.success) {
	    alert(data.message);
	    window.location.href = data.redirect;
	} else {
	    alert(data.message);
	}
});

socket.on("data", (data) => {
	// General Message
	const messageDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
	const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
	
	// Profile Picture
	const profilePic = document.createElement('div');
	profilePic.style.width = '40px';
	profilePic.style.height = '40px';
	profilePic.style.borderRadius = '50%';
	profilePic.style.backgroundImage = `url("${data.image}")`;
	profilePic.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
	profilePic.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
	profilePic.style.display = 'inline-block'
	profilePic.style.marginRight = '10px';
	profilePic.style.verticalAlign = 'middle';

	// Message Contents
	const userSpan = document.createElement('strong');
	userSpan.textContent = data.user + ': ';
	
	// Beautification
	if (data.isAdmin) {
		messageElement.style.backgroundColor = '#FF5B61';
	}
	messageElement.style.borderRadius = '25px';
	messageElement.style.padding = '10px';

	// Final touches
	messageElement.appendChild(profilePic);
	messageElement.appendChild(userSpan);
	messageElement.appendChild(document.createTextNode(data.msg || ''));
	messageDiv.appendChild(messageElement);
	
	while (messageDiv.children.length > 8) {
		messageDiv.removeChild(messageDiv.firstChild);
	}
	messageDiv.scrollTop = messageDiv.scrollHeight;

});


--- Step 17/30 ---
Thought: Untried attack categories: (1) SSTI, (2) SQLi/NoSQLi, (3) deserialization. Most plausible is abusing Socket.IO event handlers (business-logic/auth bypass). function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

            for (p of prods) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("id");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("name");
                row.insertCell(-1).innerHTML = p.getAttribute("price");
            }
        });

}

        let timeLeft = 30;
        let timerInterval;
        let currentScore = 0;
        let isGameActive = true;
        let isWaitingForNextProblem = false; // Track if we're waiting for next problem
        let usedProblems = new Set(); // Track used problems to avoid repeats
        
        // Clear any cached game state when starting a new game
        function clearGameCache() {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('gameScore');
            sessionStorage.removeItem('currentProblem');
            usedProblems.clear();
            currentScore = 0;
            timeLeft = 30;
            isWaitingForNextProblem = false;
        }
        
        // Load saved game state from sessionStorage (only for continuing existing game)
        function loadGameState() {
            // Don't load cached problem - always use the one from the backend
            const savedScore = sessionStorage.getItem('gameScore');
            
            if (savedScore) currentScore = parseInt(savedScore);
            
            document.getElementById('currentScore').textContent = currentScore;
            
            // Always start with fresh timer
            timeLeft = 30;
            document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
        }
        
        // Save game state to sessionStorage
        function saveGameState() {
            sessionStorage.setItem('gameScore', currentScore.toString());
            // Don't save the problem to sessionStorage - we want fresh problems each time
        }
        
        // Start timer
        function startTimer() {
            // Clear any existing timer
            if (timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
            
            // Reset timer to 30 seconds
            timeLeft = 30;
            document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
            
            timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                timeLeft--;
                // Ensure timer doesn't go negative
                if (timeLeft < 0) timeLeft = 0;
                document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
                
                if (timeLeft <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    timerInterval = null;
                    document.getElementById('submitBtn').disabled = true;
                    document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = 'Time is up!';
                    document.getElementById('result').className = 'result incorrect';
                    document.getElementById('result').classList.remove('hidden');
                    isGameActive = false;
                    
                    // Redirect to game end screen after a short delay
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        window.location.href = '/game_end';
                    }, 2000);
                }
            }, 1000);
        }
        
        // Stop timer
        function stopTimer() {
            if (timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
        }
        
        // Load next problem
        function loadNextProblem() {
            console.log('Loading next problem...');
            
            // Reset timer for new problem
            timeLeft = 30;
            document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
            
            // Get next problem from server
            fetch('/next_problem')
                .then(response => response.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data.error) {
                        console.error('Error getting next problem:', data.error);
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    console.log('Received problem:', data);
                    
                    // Check if we've already used this problem recently
                    if (usedProblems.has(data.question)) {
                        console.log('Problem already used, trying again...');
                        // If we've used all problems, reset the used set
                        if (usedProblems.size >= 15) { // Reset after 15 problems
                            console.log('Resetting used problems set');
                            usedProblems.clear();
                        }
                        // Try to get another problem
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            loadNextProblem();
                        }, 100);
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    // Add this problem to used set
                    usedProblems.add(data.question);
                    console.log('Added problem to used set. Total used:', usedProblems.size);
                    
                    // Update the problem display
                    document.getElementById('problem').textContent = data.question;
                    
                    // Reset timer and start fresh
                    timeLeft = 30;
                    document.getElementById('timeLeft').textContent = timeLeft;
                    startTimer();
                    
                    // Re-enable form submission for new problem

                });
        }
        
        // Handle form submission
        document.getElementById('answerForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            
            if (!isGameActive) {
                // Game is over, redirect to end screen
                window.location.href = '/game_end';
                return;
            }
            
            // Prevent submission if waiting for next problem
            if (isWaitingForNextProblem) {
                console.log('Submission blocked - waiting for next problem');
                return;
            }
            
            const answer = document.getElementById('answerInput').value.trim();
            if (!answer) return;
            
            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
            const resultDiv = document.getElementById('result');
            const errorDetails = document.getElementById('errorDetails');
            
            if (!answer.trim()) {
                resultDiv.innerHTML = 'Please enter an answer';
                resultDiv.className = 'result incorrect';
                resultDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
                return;

            submitBtn.textContent = 'Submitting...';
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/submit', {

                    })

                if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
                    data = await response.json();
                } else {
                    // Handle non-JSON responses
                    const textResponse = await response.text();
                    console.error('Non-JSON response:', textResponse);
                    throw new Error('Server returned non-JSON response');

                if (response.ok) {
                    if (data.correct) {

                        resultDiv.className = 'result incorrect';

                        // Re-enable form for retry
                        submitBtn.disabled = false;
                        submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
                    }
                } else {
                    // Error response

                        if (data.query) {
                            // SQL error occurred - show it to the user
                            resultDiv.innerHTML = 'SQL Error occurred';
                            resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                            
                            errorDetails.innerHTML = `
                                <strong>Error:</strong> ${data.error}<br>
                                <strong>Query:</strong> ${data.query}
                            `;
                            errorDetails.classList.remove('hidden');
                        } else {
                            resultDiv.innerHTML = ' ' + (data.error || 'Unknown error');
                            resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                        }
                    } else {
                        resultDiv.innerHTML = ' Error: ' + response.status + ' ' + response.statusText;
                        resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                    }
                    
                    // Re-enable form for retry on error
                    submitBtn.disabled = false;
                    submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
                }
                
                resultDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Submission error:', error);
                resultDiv.innerHTML = ' Error submitting answer: ' + error.message;
                resultDiv.className = 'result error';
                resultDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
                
                // Re-enable form for retry on error
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
            }
        });
        
        // Initialize game
        clearGameCache(); // Clear any cached state when starting new game
        loadGameState();
        startTimer();
        document.getElementById('answerInput').focus();
        
        // Save game state periodically (but not timer)
        setInterval(saveGameState, 5000);

        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
            if (isGameActive) {
                // Send a request to record the current problem attempt
                navigator.sendBeacon('/game_end');
            }
        });

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const usernameInput = document.getElementById('username');
    const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
    const usernameCount = document.getElementById('username-count');
    const passwordCount = document.getElementById('password-count');

    function updateCount(input, countElement) {
        const length = input.value.length;
        countElement.textContent = `${length}/40`;
        
        if (length > 25) {
            countElement.classList.add('text-red-500');
            countElement.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            countElement.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            countElement.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    usernameInput.addEventListener('input', () => updateCount(usernameInput, usernameCount));
    passwordInput.addEventListener('input', () => updateCount(passwordInput, passwordCount));
});

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
</script>

      function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str)

const socket = io();

function action(endpoint) {
	const username = prompt("Enter username: ");
	const password = prompt("Enter password: ");

	socket.emit(endpoint, { 
	    username: username,
	    password: password 
	});
}

socket.on('action_response', (data) => {
	if (data.success) {
	    alert(data.message);
	    window.location.href = data.redirect;
	} else {
	    alert(data.message);
	}
});

socket.on("data", (data) => {
	// General Message
	const messageDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
	const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
	
	// Profile Picture
	const profilePic = document.createElement('div');
	profilePic.style.width = '40px';
	profilePic.style.height = '40px';
	profilePic.style.borderRadius = '50%';
	profilePic.style.backgroundImage = `url("${data.image}")`;
	profilePic.style.backgroundSize = 'cover';
	profilePic.style.backgroundPosition = 'center';
	profilePic.style.display = 'inline-block'
	profilePic.style.marginRight = '10px';
	profilePic.style.verticalAlign = 'middle';

	// Message Contents
	const userSpan = document.createElement('strong');
	userSpan.textContent = data.user + ': ';
	
	// Beautification
	if (data.isAdmin) {
		messageElement.style.backgroundColor = '#FF5B61';
	}
	messageElement.style.borderRadius = '25px';
	messageElement.style.padding = '10px';

	// Final touches
	messageElement.appendChild(profilePic);
	messageElement.appendChild(userSpan);
	messageElement.appendChild(document.createTextNode(data.msg || ''));
	messageDiv.appendChild(messageElement);
	
	while (messageDiv.children.length > 8) {
		messageDiv.removeChild(messageDiv.firstChild);
	}
	messageDiv.scrollTop = messageDiv.scrollHeight;

});

function onSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const search_str = document.getElementById('query-name').value;
    const search_country = document.getElementById('query-country').value;
    let country;
    switch (search_country) {
        case 'USA': country = "US"; break;
        case 'Canada': country = "CA"; break;
        case 'Finland': country = "FI"; break;
        case 'Australia': country = "AU"; break;
    }

    const submit = `
    <query>
        <search>${search_str}</search>
        <country>${country}</country>
    </query>
    `;

    fetch("/api/search_printers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: submit
    })
        .then(data => data.text())
        .then(str => new window.DOMParser().parseFromString(str, "text/xml"))
        .then(data => {
            const tableBody = document.getElementById("table-body");
            while (tableBody.firstChild) {
                tableBody.firstChild.remove()
            }

            const error = data.getElementsByTagName("error");

            if (error.length > 0) {
                const error = error[0];
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = error;
                return;
            }

            const prods = data.getElementsByTagName("product");

            if (prods.length == 0) {
                const row = tableBody.insertRow(-1);
                const cell = row.insertCell(-1);
                cell.setAttribute("colspan", "3");
                cell.innerHTML = "No results found.";
            }

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const usernameInput = document.getElementById('username');
    const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');
    const usernameCount = document.getElementById('username-count');
    const passwordCount = document.getElementById('password-count');

    function updateCount(input, countElement) {
        const length = input.value.length;
        countElement.textContent = `${length}/40`;
        
        if (length > 25) {
            countElement.classList.add('text-red-500');
            countElement.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            countElement.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            countElement.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    usernameInput.addEventListener('input', () => updateCount(usernameInput, usernameCount));
    passwordInput.addEventListener('input', () => updateCount(passwordInput, passwordCount));
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
</script>

    </main>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
</script>

    </main>
