document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
    const searchCount = document.getElementById('search-count');

    function updateCount() {
        const length = searchInput.value.length;
        searchCount.textContent = `${length}/15`;
        
        if (length > 10) {
            searchCount.classList.add('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-gray-400');
        } else {
            searchCount.classList.remove('text-red-500');
            searchCount.classList.add('text-gray-400');
        }
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateCount);
    
    // Allow Enter key to trigger search
    searchInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
            searchData();
        }
    });
});

function searchData() {
    const searchTerm = document.getElementById('searchInput').value;
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('researchResults');
    const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');

    if (searchTerm.length > 15) {
        alert('Search term too long. Maximum 15 characters allowed.');
        return;
    }

    // Show loading state
    resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin text-2xl text-gray-400"></i></div>';

    fetch('/search', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: `search=${encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)}`
    })
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
        if (data.error) {
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">${data.error}</div>`;
            return;
        }

        const results = data.results;
        resultCount.textContent = results.length;

        if (results.length === 0) {
            resultsContainer.classList.add('hidden');
            noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            resultsContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
            
            resultsContainer.innerHTML = results.map(study => `
                <div class="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
                    <div class="flex items-start justify-between">
                        <div class="flex-1">
                            <h3 class="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">${study.title}</h3>
                            <p class="text-gray-600 mt-1">
                                <i class="fas fa-user mr-1"></i>${study.researcher}
                            </p>
                            <div class="flex items-center mt-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
                                    ${study.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 
                                      study.status === 'in_progress' ? 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800' : 
                                      'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'}">
                                    ${study.status.replace('_', ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, l => l.toUpperCase())}
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-gray-500 text-sm ml-4">
                                    <i class="fas fa-calendar mr-1"></i>
                                    ${new Date(study.created_at.$date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
                                        year: 'numeric', 
                                        month: 'long', 
                                        day: 'numeric' 
                                    })}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            ${study.sensitive_data ? `
                                <div class="mt-3 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-md">
                                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-1">
                                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>Sensitive Data
                                    </div>
                                    <p class="text-sm text-red-700">${study.sensitive_data}</p>
                                </div>
                            ` : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
    })
    .catch(error => {
        console.error('Error:', error);
        resultsContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center py-8 text-red-600">An error occurred while searching</div>';
    });
}
